notes: Launch manifest for the accepted Docket v0.1 project (identity-md-launches/launch-197-build-docket-v0-1-smallest), adapted for the evm_project launch kind. Application contract: src/Docket.sol:Docket, deployed unchanged from the accepted release; src/Docket.sol, script/Deploy.s.sol, foundry.toml and the accepted tests are byte-identical to the upstream repository. Docket is a permissionless board whose text lives only in transaction logs (IdeaCreated, CommentPosted, Upvoted). It has a nonpayable constructor with no arguments, does not read msg.sender in its constructor, and has no owner, admin, pauser, fee recipient, upgrade path, ETH acceptance, DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. No argument uses $owner, $token or $contract:* and Docket never references the token. No initialization calls are needed or made. Build configuration is the accepted one: solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200 runs, evm_version cancun, bytecode_hash none. Token entry: src/LaunchToken.sol:LaunchToken, a dependency-free fixed-supply ERC-20 with the constants name Docket, symbol DOCKET and 18 decimals; totalSupply is the compile-time constant 10^27 minor units minted once to msg.sender (the factory) in its no-argument constructor. It has no mint, burn, owner, pause, blocklist, fee, hook, proxy, receive or fallback function. The pool entry concerns the launch token only: native ETH (zero address), fee 3000, tickSpacing 60, reference sqrtPriceX96 2^96 (price 1:1); the effective opening price comes from the pinned policy's initialMarketCapWei where that policy defines it; there is no hook. Constructor dependency order is trivial: LaunchToken then Docket, neither depends on the other. Brief conflict, stated for the admission reviewer: the original brief asked for a contract-only release with no token or pool. Review finding 2d4df2a3e4480f72d4bcd316903c9250cdbd67d5bda8a85c61b7a9845dbe0a80 (medium, reopened) reports that this manifest names LaunchToken and an ETH pool anyway. Reproduced: token and pool are non-null objects and the finding's assertion fails as described. Disputed as a manifest defect: the canonical LaunchManifest schema requires token and pool objects (checked with ajv draft 2020-12: this manifest validates; the same manifest with token and pool null or omitted is rejected, as the upstream draft was), the protected project floor deploys IMD_TOKEN_CREATION_CODE and requires a positive supply held by the factory, and this assignment's instructions name LaunchToken in src/LaunchToken.sol as the launch token and require token and pool objects. No valid evm_project manifest can express a tokenless launch, so the remedy the finding asks for cannot be applied in launch.json, the only file this task may change. The token is the protocol's reward artifact only; Docket's source, ABI and bytecode are unchanged and Docket cannot hold, mint or reference it. The open item the finding identifies is service-side: either a recorded requester decision authorizing LaunchToken and the pool, or a contract-only admission and deployment path. That decision belongs to admission, not to this manifest, which authorizes nothing. Audit finding 45d7c9e53ac8db3d9ee2abe9b15f5778df42a6684060c9ea182d88c6da86aa6c (the earlier manifest set token to null and could not validate) is fixed by this manifest. test/LaunchToken.t.sol mirrors the protected token and project floors (factory holds the whole supply across Docket's constructor, admin and mint selectors revert, runtime bounded with no escape opcodes). Local checks: forge build --offline clean; forge test --offline 68 passed, 0 failed. Admission, deployment, address/transaction/block recording, explorer verification with the standard-JSON input, and publication are performed by the network's deployer after review; this manifest names no wallet.
